landed: After a stable elected operation returns, active members run READERS_EXITED, an empty local batch, and OWNER_SERVICE_DONE as fixed tree rounds. The phase message carries the cohort epoch. A broadcast that does not match is recorded in ack_phase_fault and does not service. Resize and OP_VM_RESIZE_RESULT skip the window so both membership frames keep the same barrier count. The completion prefix and examination cursor stay unchanged. A sync interrupt raised in the window stays pending.
notLanded: No per-entry ACK debt, no RC unlink, no scanner-next proof, and no checked park. thread-save! does not by itself publish a freeze certificate. Park is not an internal ___call suspension, callbacks do not repark, and the parent continuation is not held until host-body completion. GC worker count is still logical processor_count. P0 is not given a park path. Rollback, rejoin failure, and the shutdown rejoin lane are not implemented.
notNineOfTwelve: No still-joinable ___thread_join error is recorded. qualify_nine_of_twelve stays 8/12.
